title: E0111: Deprecated mysql Extension
plain_english: Using removed `ext/mysql` functions (`mysql_connect()`, `mysql_query()`, etc.) causes fatal errors on PHP 7.0+ and lacks prepared statement support.
why_matters: The original `ext/mysql` extension was removed in PHP 7.0. Any code using these functions will crash with a fatal error on PHP 7.0+. The extension also lacks support for prepared statements, making it inherently vulnerable to SQL injection.
what_it_checks: Any function with the `mysql_` prefix (except `mysqlnd`, which is a driver, not the extension)
